records.source_title: Tennant Company - Investor Relations: Corporate Overview
records.excerpt: Its products include equipment for maintaining surfaces in industrial, commercial and outdoor environments; detergent-free and other sustainable cleaning technologies; and cleaning tools and supplies. Tennant's global field service network is the most extensive in the industry. Tennant has manufacturing operations throughout the world and sells products directly in 21 countries and through distributors in more than 100 countries.
records.population: Industrial, commercial and outdoor surface-maintenance buyers
records.does_not_establish: It does not say whether any product or channel reaches households or individual buyers.

records.source_title: Tennant Company Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2025
records.excerpt: Customers include contract cleaners to whom organizations outsource facilities maintenance as well as businesses that perform facilities maintenance themselves. The Company reaches these customers through the industry's largest direct sales and service organization and through a strong and well-supported network of authorized distributors worldwide.
records.population: Contract cleaners and businesses doing their own facilities maintenance
records.does_not_establish: It does not show any demand from, or sales to, individual consumers.

records.source_title: Tennant Company Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2025
records.excerpt: In accordance with the objective and basic principles of the applicable accounting guidance, we aggregate our operating segments into one reportable segment that consists of the design, manufacture and sale of products used primarily in the maintenance of nonresidential surfaces.
records.population: Whole company (single reportable segment)
records.does_not_establish: It does not quantify how much, if anything, is sold for residential use; "primarily" leaves that open.

records.source_title: Tennant Company Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2025
records.excerpt: Sales direct to consumer $ 212.3 $ 222.6 $ 633.9 $ 673.7 Sales to distributors 91.0 93.2 278.0 284.1
records.population: Net sales by channel, USD millions (Q3 2025, Q3 2024, nine months 2025, nine months 2024)
records.does_not_establish: The filing elsewhere describes customers as contract cleaners and businesses, so this "direct to consumer" line most likely means direct to end customers, not households; it does not show household sales.

records.source_title: Tennant Company Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results
records.excerpt: Delivered net sales of $303.3 million for the third quarter of 2025, reflecting a 4.0% decrease from the third quarter of 2024, or a 5.4% organic decline.
records.population: Whole company
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how much spare capacity, cash or management attention could go to a new customer group.

records.source_title: Tennant Company Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results
records.excerpt: Announced the launch of the T360 walk-behind scrubber as the latest addition to our mid-tier growth strategy. The T360 delivers solid cleaning performance at an economical price point ideal for tight customer budgets and simple, intuitive operation helpful to onboarding first-time users.
records.population: Budget-constrained commercial buyers and first-time machine operators
records.does_not_establish: A lower-priced commercial machine is not a consumer product, and this says nothing about household demand or price points.

records.source_title: Tennant Company Launches New Commercial Floor Scrubbers
records.excerpt: The CS5 Micro-Scrubber enables smaller-footprint areas to drop the mop and get a higher level of clean.
records.population: Small commercial spaces (the release names convenience stores, restaurants, health and education facilities)
records.does_not_establish: It does not show that the CS5 or any compact machine is sold to, or suitable for, households.

records.source_title: 2024 results: Nilfisk announces 1.2% organic growth and an improvement of margins
records.excerpt: Nilfisk’s 2024 financial results show organic growth of 1.2% driven by positive organic growth in the Consumer (19.7%), Specialty (4.9%), and Service (0.6%) Businesses, partially offset by Professional (-0.9%).
records.population: Nilfisk, a competing professional cleaning-equipment maker, by business line
records.does_not_establish: One year's growth from a small base at a competitor does not show that Tennant could win consumers or earn similar margins.

records.source_title: 2024 results: Nilfisk announces 1.2% organic growth and an improvement of margins
records.excerpt: More than 90% of sales are to professionals while the remaining part of the business aimed at consumers covers floorcare equipment, vacuum cleaners, and high-pressure washers.
records.population: Nilfisk sales split between professional and consumer buyers
records.does_not_establish: It does not give the profitability of the consumer business or say whether it helps or hurts the professional brand.

records.source_title: Q2 2024 results: Significant progress in Nilfisk’s Consumer Business
records.excerpt: Revenue increased in the Consumer Business, with organic growth of 18.1% in the second quarter of 2024. This is attributed to seasonally-related high demand for high pressure washers, along with Nilfisk’s growing market share in Western Europe for high pressure washers as well as vacuum cleaners.
records.population: Nilfisk consumer buyers of pressure washers and vacuum cleaners
records.does_not_establish: The growth came from pressure washers and vacuums, not floor scrubbers, so it does not show household demand for scrubber-type machines.

records.source_title: New sales record in 2023: Kärcher remains on course (press release)
records.excerpt: Private customers and professional users contribute roughly the same amount to the cleaning specialist's turnover.
records.population: Kärcher, a competitor selling to both private and professional buyers
records.does_not_establish: Kärcher built its consumer business over decades with retail distribution; this does not show what a late entrant could reach.

records.source_title: Record revenue of 3.483 billion euros: Kärcher weathers the storms (press release)
records.excerpt: In the reporting year, the company faced a lot of headwind: increasing barriers to trade, such as tariffs and local subsidies, high pressure on prices especially from Chinese manufacturers, as well as structural and regulatory hurdles all slowed down growth significantly. The cleaning market as a whole has seen a downward trend recently, primarily due to purchasing restraint among commercial customers and only some parts of the consumer segment registered an increase in sales – Kärcher, however, came off well overall.
records.population: Cleaning-equipment market, commercial and consumer
records.does_not_establish: It does not say which consumer categories grew or by how much.

records.source_title: Roomba maker iRobot files for bankruptcy protection
records.excerpt: iRobot generated about $682 million in revenue in 2024, but mounting pressure from Chinese competitors such as Ecovacs Robotics has weighed heavily on profitability, according to court filings. While iRobot remains a market leader in the United States and Japan, competitors have forced the company to cut prices and invest heavily in technology upgrades to stay relevant.
records.population: Household robot-vacuum market
records.does_not_establish: Robot vacuums are one consumer floor-cleaning category; this does not describe margins for other household machines such as wet-dry floor washers.

records.source_title: iRobot files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy after increased competition, tariff woes
records.excerpt: With a hold of about 42% of the U.S. market and 65% in Japan, it should've been in a good position. Indeed, it was valued at approximately $3.56 billion in 2021. However, as of December, it's now valued at an estimated $140 million.
records.population: Household robot-vacuum market
records.does_not_establish: It does not establish that high share in consumer floor care is unprofitable in general; tariffs and a failed acquisition also played a part.

records.source_title: Tineco tops wet & dry vacuum market for fourth year
records.excerpt: The recognition strengthens Tineco's position in a floorcare segment that has grown as consumers seek machines that wash hard floors while collecting dirty water and debris in the same process. Tineco reports more than 24 million users worldwide, with products stocked in more than 10,000 retail locations.
records.population: Household wet-dry floor-washer buyers
records.does_not_establish: The figures come from Tineco and a Euromonitor ranking it cites; they do not show room for a premium entrant or what buyers would pay.

records.source_title: SharkNinja Reports Second Quarter 2024 Results
records.excerpt: Adjusted Net Sales of Cleaning Appliances increased by $78.5 million, or 20.3%, from $387.6 million to $466.1 million, driven by the carpet extractor and cordless vacuums sub-categories.
records.population: SharkNinja household cleaning-appliance buyers
records.does_not_establish: It does not split out carpet-extractor sales or show demand for heavier, professional-grade machines.

records.source_title: Rug Doctor Reinvents With New Products, Branding, Plano HQ
records.excerpt: With the launch, Rug Doctor plans to release all-new products — including the Pro Detailer & Portable Spot Cleaner and the Pro Deep Upright Carpet Cleaner — and optimize efficiencies at 40,000 retail locations including Walmart and Kroger.
records.population: Households renting carpet-cleaning machines through retailers
records.does_not_establish: It is from 2017 and covers carpet rental, not hard-floor scrubbing; it does not show current demand.

records.source_title: About Us - Rug Doctor by BISSELL
records.excerpt: The first Rug Doctor carpet cleaning machine was created by a professional carpet cleaner in his garage in the early 1970s, because he believed people should have a more accessible and affordable option to professional services. It quickly gained popularity and began to appear in grocery and hardware stores. Today Rug Doctor machines are used by DIYers and Professionals.
records.population: DIY households and professionals using rental machines
records.does_not_establish: It is a company history, not evidence of current rental volumes or of demand for floor-scrubber rental.

records.source_title: ACI Survey Finds Most Americans Spring Clean
records.excerpt: Other planned tasks for this spring included cleaning appliances (71%), washing bedclothes and linens (70%), and scrubbing the floors (69%).
records.population: US adults planning to spring clean (Wakefield Research for the American Cleaning Institute, 2023 survey)
records.does_not_establish: Planning to scrub floors once a year does not show willingness to buy a machine for it.

records.source_title: Belimo Annual Report 2025 (Sustainability Report: Business Model & Value Chain)
records.excerpt: Belimo is a global market leader in the development, production, and sales of field devices for the energy-efficient control of heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems. The focus of its core business is on damper actuators, control valves, sensors and meters.
records.population: Whole company
records.does_not_establish: It does not say whether any of these devices are sold to homeowners.

records.source_title: Belimo Annual Report 2025 (Sustainability Report: Business Model & Value Chain)
records.excerpt: With an emphasis on product quality, durability with minimal maintenance, and highly innovative, technically advanced solutions, the Company has become a preferred choice in high-performance applications in large commercial buildings such as data centers, hospitals, schools and universities, offices, governmental buildings, infrastructure and industrial sites.
records.population: Large commercial building applications
records.does_not_establish: It does not rule out small residential sales; it only shows where the company sees its strength.

records.source_title: Belimo Annual Report 2025 (Sustainability Report: Business Model & Value Chain)

It provides them with extensive technical support, including planning, customization, calibration, and troubleshooting – and conducts training for HVAC professionals to optimize installation effectiveness.
records.population: HVAC OEMs, system integrators and HVAC professionals
records.does_not_establish: It does not show whether these partners would carry or install a consumer-facing product.

records.source_title: Ad hoc Announcement of the Belimo Group: Belimo Accelerated Sales Growth in 2025
records.excerpt: Belimo delivered accelerated sales growth of 23.3% year-on-year in local currencies (2024: +13.1%), leading to CHF 1 121 million sales in 2025.
records.population: Whole company
records.does_not_establish: It does not show any sales to individual buyers or the margin a consumer line would need to match.

records.source_title: Ad hoc Announcement of the Belimo Group: Belimo Accelerated Sales Growth in 2025
records.excerpt: Despite a slowdown of global non-residential construction spending, growth was accelerated in both Belimo’s traditional HVAC business and data center cooling solutions — the latter accounting for slightly less than half of Belimo’s sales growth in 2025.
records.population: Traditional HVAC and data center cooling customers
records.does_not_establish: It does not establish that a consumer move would compete with data centers for resources; that is an inference.

records.source_title: Ad hoc Announcement of the Belimo Group: Belimo Accelerated Sales Growth in 2025
records.excerpt: Furthermore, Belimo’s RetroFIT+ initiative, launched in 2021 and targeting renovations, gained traction. Building owners are increasingly embracing Belimo technology to retrofit older HVAC systems in buildings to reduce energy consumption and improve system reliability.
records.population: Building owners renovating HVAC systems
records.does_not_establish: The building owners here are commercial; it does not show that homeowners would retrofit with Belimo devices.

records.source_title: Belimo Company Presentation 2026
records.excerpt: We Serve Two Main Channels in HVAC OEM and contracting Consulting Engineers Belimo Sales Companies BELIMO Automation AG Contracting (56%)
records.population: Sales channels (the slide gives contracting 56% and OEM 44%)
records.does_not_establish: Slide labels are read in extraction order; the slide names end users such as owners and tenants but does not say how many are households.

records.source_title: Belimo Now Offers HVAC Zone Solutions for Residential Applications
records.excerpt: DANBURY, Conn. — Belimo Americas, a manufacturer of damper actuators and control valves for commercial HVAC, announced the availability of products for residential applications with select actuators, round damper assemblies, and pressure bypass damper controls.
records.population: Residential HVAC zoning, sold through HVAC trades
records.does_not_establish: It is from 2015 and does not show whether the residential line is still sold, how large it is, or that it reaches homeowners directly.

records.source_title: Products and Solutions - Resideo

records.population: Resideo (Honeywell Home) residential comfort and security buyers
records.does_not_establish: It does not give the share of DIY sales or their profitability.

records.population: Homeowners buying through HVAC contractors
records.does_not_establish: It shows one channel design for home thermostats, not whether homeowners would pay for Belimo-grade devices.

records.source_title: Danfoss Ally - smart heating
records.excerpt: And today, ensuring superior temperature precision is still at the very core of our DNA. So much so, that we have built the Danfoss Ally™ software on top of our market-leading experience and expertise from the thermostat and valve industry.
records.population: Homeowners with radiator and hydronic floor heating

records.population: Consumer smart-thermostat market
records.does_not_establish: It describes one start-up; it does not show what an established component maker would spend or earn.

records.population: Consumer smart-thermostat market
records.does_not_establish: It reports a company claim of operating profitability, not audited figures, and gives no margin.

records.source_title: Google goes cold on Europe: Stops making smart thermostats for continental conditions

records.population: Consumer smart-thermostat market
records.does_not_establish: Google's exit reflects its own priorities; it does not show that a hydronics specialist would face the same difficulty.

records.source_title: Airthings ASA - Q4 2025 trading update
records.excerpt: Total revenue for 2025 is expected to be USD 33.3 million dollar with 7% growth in the Business segment and 21% growth in the Pro segment, while Consumer revenues decreased 20% following the strategic decision to prioritize margin improvement.
records.population: Consumer and business buyers of indoor air-quality monitors
records.does_not_establish: Figures are unaudited and from one small company; they do not describe the whole room-climate device market.

records.source_title: Airthings Q2 2025 press release
records.excerpt: Gross profit grew year-on-year in the Business and Pro segments, while gross profit in the Consumer segment was impacted negatively by a weakening US consumer sentiment, US tariffs and costs related to promotions and campaigns with key retail partners.
records.population: Consumer buyers of indoor air-quality monitors
records.does_not_establish: It covers one quarter at one company and does not separate the effect of tariffs from weak demand.

records.source_title: Few U.S. homes choose to program their thermostats (Today in Energy)
records.excerpt: But even for those households that use central air conditioning and have a programmable thermostat, more than two-thirds of those households control temperatures without actually programming the thermostat.
records.population: US households with central air conditioning (2015 RECS)
records.does_not_establish: It is 2015 survey data on programmable thermostats; it does not measure how people use newer smart devices.

records.source_title: ENERGY STAR Smart Thermostats
records.excerpt: Smart thermostats that earn the ENERGY STAR label have been independently certified, based on actual field data, to deliver energy savings.
records.population: US households buying smart thermostats
records.does_not_establish: Certified savings for thermostats do not show savings or demand for valve- or damper-level devices in homes.

records.source_title: About us - Laerdal Medical (US)
records.excerpt: For more than 60 years, Laerdal Medical has been dedicated to supporting the advancement of Resuscitation Science. Our offering includes training solutions for both community and professional first responders.
records.population: Community and professional first responders
records.does_not_establish: It does not say how much of the business comes from community or individual buyers.

records.source_title: CPR training with a bra: small design choices can mean life or death for women (press release)
records.excerpt: Laerdal Medical is a global leader in healthcare education and resuscitation training, using advanced technology and data-driven insights to improve survival rates and enhance the quality of care. We empower our heroes and lifesavers – healthcare professionals – to help them save more lives.
records.population: Healthcare professionals
records.does_not_establish: It does not exclude consumer sales; it states the company's chosen focus.

records.source_title: CPR training with a bra: small design choices can mean life or death for women (press release)
records.excerpt: The Laerdal Group includes Laerdal Medical, Laerdal Global Health, the Million Lives Fund, and the Laerdal Foundation. Laerdal is a global company with a presence in 27 countries.
records.population: Whole group
records.does_not_establish: It gives no revenue, profit or ownership figures; those were not found in public English sources.

records.source_title: CPR Anytime - Laerdal Medical
records.excerpt: CPR Anytime is a flexible program that allows you to learn CPR at your own pace, in the comfort and privacy of your home. The kits can also facilitate large CPR training programs in school, workplace, or community settings. The kit is portable, making it easy to share with family members or close friends – resulting in more people trained.
records.population: Individuals and families learning CPR at home; schools, workplaces and communities
records.does_not_establish: It shows a home-use kit already exists; it does not show how many are bought by individuals rather than organisations.

records.source_title: CPR Anytime - Laerdal Medical
records.excerpt: CPR Anytime is intended for anyone who wants to learn basic CPR but doesn’t need a course completion card to meet a job requirement.
records.population: Lay learners who do not need certification
records.does_not_establish: It does not show demand, price sensitivity or repeat purchase among these learners.

records.source_title: CPR manikins - Laerdal Medical (Australia)
records.excerpt: Mini manikins are inflatable kits explicitly designed to meet the needs of organisations and schools to train groups of bystanders. Minis are great for large training events, CPR school initiatives, and self-training, as it allows participants to practice CPR while watching the skills demonstrated by the instructor or instruction video.
records.population: Organisations and schools training bystanders; self-trainers
records.does_not_establish: It does not say whether self-training buyers pay themselves or receive kits from organisations.

records.source_title: Laerdal strengthens its commitment to the military and emergency medical services (press release)
records.excerpt: At a time marked by geopolitical instability, war in Europe, and growing demands for national preparedness, Laerdal is strengthening its focus on competence, learning, and collaboration in emergency medical services, both civilian and military.
records.population: Civilian and military emergency medical services
records.does_not_establish: It does not say a consumer move is ruled out; it only shows another segment the company is prioritising.

records.source_title: Survey shows more Americans prepared to perform CPR in cardiac emergencies
records.excerpt: Today, more than 350,000 cardiac arrests occur outside of hospitals in the United States annually. Nearly three out of four of those cardiac arrests happen in homes.
records.population: Out-of-hospital cardiac arrests (American Heart Association figures)
records.does_not_establish: A large share of home arrests does not show that households will buy training products.

records.source_title: Survey shows more Americans prepared to perform CPR in cardiac emergencies
records.excerpt: Based on the available data at the time, and tracking attitudes since, the Association has since seen a reported increase from 33% to 39% in bystander confidence to be able to perform any type of CPR -- or 17.7 million more Americans feeling confident to act in the event of a lifesaving emergency.
records.population: US adults (American Heart Association survey research)
records.does_not_establish: Self-reported confidence is not training uptake or purchase intent, and the survey method is not given here.

records.source_title: Statewide Initiative Associated with Improved Cardiac Arrest Outcomes
records.excerpt: In 2010, bystanders administered CPR in 61 percent of public cases and 28.3 percent of in-home cases. In 2014, the rate of bystander CPR rose to 70.6 percent of public cases and 41.3 percent of in-home cases.
records.population: Out-of-hospital cardiac arrests, public and in-home
records.does_not_establish: The rise followed a broad statewide programme, so it does not show what home training kits alone achieve.

records.source_title: ILCOR Evidence-to-Decision table: BLS training for high-risk populations (EIT 649)
records.excerpt: Given these facts we considered it important to recommend that health care professionals encourage and direct these groups to attend BLS training even though they may not take up training (Greenberg 2011, 166).
records.population: Family members and carers of people at high risk of cardiac arrest
records.does_not_establish: It is a guideline judgement, not a market study, and it does not say who should pay for training.

records.source_title: Teach yourself CPR — in privacy of your home
records.excerpt: Now enter the $30 Mini Anne kit, called CPR Anytime. The idea: More people might learn CPR if they didn’t have to attend a four-hour class — and having your own at-home mannequin allows more practice time than sharing classroom mannequins does.
records.population: Individuals learning CPR at home
records.does_not_establish: It is from 2006 and describes the launch idea, not later sales or use.

records.source_title: Manikin may not be necessary for basic CPR training
records.excerpt: But the new study shows that for the general public, where cost and time may be more of an issue, training that uses video only can be as effective in helping people learn basic CPR as using a kit that includes a manikin, says Blewer.
records.population: Family members of hospitalised patients at risk of cardiac arrest (cluster randomised trial, eight hospitals)
records.does_not_establish: The trial measured skills, not survival, and found deeper compressions with the manikin kit; it does not show the manikin has no value.

records.source_title: Learn CPR in 15 minutes - British Heart Foundation
records.excerpt: RevivR is our free, interactive, online CPR training course. In just 15 minutes, you can learn how to save a life and receive your very own CPR certificate. It couldn’t be simpler – you just need your mobile phone or tablet and a cushion to practice on.
records.population: General public learning CPR
records.does_not_establish: It shows a free substitute exists; it does not show how many users would otherwise have bought a manikin.

records.source_title: Laerdal Adult & Child CPR Anytime Kit - AED.com
records.excerpt: Laerdal Adult & Child CPR Anytime Kit Out of stock SKU 15-1014 $47.00
records.population: Online buyers of CPR training kits
records.does_not_establish: One retailer price and stock status do not show sales volume or who the buyers are.

records.source_title: Dartmouth Health Children’s distributes infant CPR home training kits for families of babies treated in intensive care nursery
records.excerpt: LEBANON – The intensive care nursery (ICN) at Children’s Hospital at Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center (CHaD), New Hampshire’s only children’s hospital, recently received a donation of 500 Infant CPR Anytime kits from the American Heart Association (AHA), funded by the Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield Foundation. The kits contain tools to help new parents learn the lifesaving skills of infant CPR and infant choking relief in as little as 20 minutes and are being distributed to families being discharged from the ICN.
records.population: Parents of infants discharged from intensive care
records.does_not_establish: One hospital programme funded by a foundation does not show whether parents would pay for kits themselves.

records.source_title: New Cleveland Clinic Survey: Only Half Of Americans Say They Know CPR
records.excerpt: The survey found that slightly more than half of Americans (54 percent) say they know how to perform CPR; however, only one in six know that the recommended technique for bystander CPR consists of just chest compressions – and no breaths – on an adult.
records.population: US adults (online survey of 1,007 adults, October 2017)
records.does_not_establish: A knowledge gap does not show willingness to pay to close it.
